question: FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup 2022 will be organised by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup**, an** international women's youth football competition** played every two years between the u**nder-17 national teams of FIFA **member organisations, reached its seventh iteration in 2022.
 
• The **first competition took place in 2008. India** served as the host nation for the competition; however, the 2020 edition was postponed owing to the **COVID-19 epidemic.**
 
• After the 2017 **FIFA U-17 World Cup** for men, it was India's second time hosting a **FIFA** event, and it was also the country's first** FIFA women's football event.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An **international association football competition** for female players under the age of 17 is known as the** FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup.**
 
• **Federation Internationale de Football Association **is in charge of organising it (**FIFA**).
 
• Since 2008, the competition has been held in even-numbered years.
 
• Spain is the reigning champion after taking home a **second championship in 2022 in India.**
